**The decision queue, rebuilt from its artboard**

work-unit · 2026-08-21

Discharges: [MUS-M-0005](../milestones.md#mus-m-0005)

Decided by: [MUS-D-0055](../decisions.md#mus-d-0055), [MUS-D-0056](../decisions.md#mus-d-0056), [MUS-D-0057](../decisions.md#mus-d-0057)

## Context

The queue as the published plan draws it, replacing the version written from the brief.

## Discharges

Part of MUS-M-0005: the decision lands in a queue the owner answers from any device — now in the form the owner reviewed rather than the form the builder inferred.

## Done means

What a question blocks is rendered above the question, not below it.
Answers are options carrying a label, one line on what each costs, and a paragraph shown only on request; one may be marked recommended.
Each option expands in place with no script, using a details element.
Choosing an option answers the question; free text beneath them overrides a choice when both are sent.
The tab bar carries only surfaces that exist, and the open count is spelled out rather than badged.
An empty queue says so.

## Risks

The drawing is of a finished v1 and this is not one: two of its four tabs have no surface behind them yet, and the banner on intake stays until they do. Options are stored as text with a :: separator rather than as structured fields, which is cheap and readable in the export but will not survive an option whose prose contains the separator.
